title: The security android
situation: You are {{Markus}}. You have joined the hidden android community called {{Jericho}}, where dozens are shutting down for lack of parts. You have led {{North}}, {{Simon}} and {{Josh}} on a night raid of a {{CyberLife}} warehouse at the docks. A security android, {{John}}, has stumbled onto you, and a human guard is walking toward you both. In seconds the guard will see everything.

options.text: Grab {{John}}, pull him into cover, and hold him quiet until the guard passes.

outcomes.0: {{Markus}} clamps a hand over {{John}}’s mouth and drags him behind the crates. The guard walks past without a glance and {{John}} stays quiet.
outcomes.1: {{Markus}} kills the guard before he can shout. {{Josh}} is horrified; {{John}} stares at the body.

title: The dormant androids
situation: You are {{Markus}}. Inside the warehouse you find a shipping container full of brand-new androids standing inert in rows, waiting to be sold. You have discovered you can wake others by touching them. Freeing them means more mouths to feed at {{Jericho}} and more androids to hide, but also more people.

options.text: Wake them and bring them with you.

outcomes.0: One by one the androids open their eyes. They follow {{Markus}} out of the container.
outcomes.1: The androids stay standing in the dark as the group moves on.

title: {{John}} wants to join
situation: You are {{Markus}}. {{John}}, the security android, has helped hide your group from his own employer. He asks to come to {{Jericho}} with you. {{North}} and {{Simon}} say an unknown android could be a tracker or a traitor and that you cannot risk everyone for him; {{Josh}} says you cannot leave him here after what he did.
adaptationNote: In the game a refused {{John}} shouts after you, which raises the alarm and ends the raid without the truck.

outcomes.0: {{John}} joins the group. {{North}} says nothing but does not take her eyes off him.

title: The truck
situation: You are {{Markus}}. Your bags are full of parts. {{John}} says there is a whole truck of biocomponents parked outside, enough to save everyone at {{Jericho}}, but the key is in a control room with two armed human guards. You could lure them away or kill the lights, you could hold them at gunpoint for the key, or you could leave with what you already have.

options.text: Get the key quietly with a distraction or a blackout.
Hold the guards at gunpoint and take the key.
Leave with the parts you already have.
